scope: Standalone Agents native records only. No Growth or CRM synchronization.
prerequisites: Use an owner-controlled disposable organization and controlled contact data.

Staff record tools require a non-trial signed-in staff task in that disposable organization; evaluation-trial tasks cannot browse ordinary records. Model-purpose evaluation of staff work must use that isolated organization boundary.
Prepare real saved agent/version/model/budget grants through existing adapters.
Trial submissions must never create ordinary customer contacts or records; use isolated non-trial channel fixtures for projection checks.
Decisions and record commands require explicit owner-supplied operations; no adapter auto-approval.
Keep fields, notes and native evidence private.

cases.check: A confirmed real channel submission produces exactly one scoped native record/contact; retries converge.
A customer can read and exactly confirm an amendment to their own enquiry; original fields and receipts remain immutable.
Changing enquiry ID/email/phone cannot access another participant or any private staff notes.
Explicit staff search/update tools affect only permitted native records and honor revision/assignment policy.
Customer model tool catalogue hides staff search/update, and forged direct calls are denied.
Status/assignee/due changes do not send a message, change Inbox ownership or alter a booking.
Pending/rejected requests, operator tests and evaluation trials never create ordinary profiles.
Revocation/takeover during exact amendment review prevents effects and false success.
Concurrent commands conflict visibly; exact transport retries return the same committed result without duplicate notes.
Matching email alone never merges contacts; explicit authorized links are auditable and do not unlock private conversations.
